items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHg3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--24c36c7429ebfb000d0e3d5923abffb184db306d/Cubo%20m%C3%A1gico%20cartaz%20(1).jpg)![] 🇧🇷 O Cubo Mágico, inventado pelo professor de arquitetura húngaro Ernő Rubik, comemora seu 50º aniversário neste ano. Por ocasião deste jubileu, o Consulado-Geral da Hungria e a Associação Brasiliense de Cubo Mágico organizam conjuntamente uma competição comemorativa do inconfundível quebra-cabeça. Venha, participe, desafie-se! Esta competição será gratuita. Para se inscrever, vá para a aba "Inscrever". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). --- 🇺🇸 The Rubik’s Cube, invented by Hungarian architecture professor Ernő Rubik, celebrates its 50th anniversary this year. On the occasion of this jubilee, the Consulate General of Hungary in Sao Paulo and the Brazilian Magic Cube Association jointly organizes a competition celebrating the world famous puzzle. Join us, participate, and challenge yourself! This competition will be free. To register, go to the tab "Register". If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

venue.name: [대구텍스타일콤플렉스 (Daegu Textile Complex)](http://dtcomplex.org/main.do)

items.information: ### 시리즈별 대회장이 다릅니다. 주의하세요. ### A대회 : 세미나실 1 ### B, C대회 : 세미나실 3 ### 본 대회는 시리즈 대회의 일환으로, 시리즈 대회 중 하나의 대회에만 참가할 수 있습니다. 관련 안내 사항을 [시리즈 대회 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43995-about-the-series-competitions)에서 확인 바랍니다. ### 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다. ### 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 갱신되니, 참가 신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 참가비 납부는 [대회 신청 및 참가비 납부](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43887-registration-and-payment-details) 탭을 눌러 확인해주세요. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. ___ ### Series competitions have different venues. Be careful. ### A Series : Seminar rooms 1 ### B, C Series : Seminar rooms 3 ### This competition is part of a series competitions, meaning that you can only participate in one competition of the series. See [About the Series Competitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43995-about-the-series-competitions) for more information. ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### Within 3 days of paying the registration fee, you should be able to see your name on either the competitor list or waitlist. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. Please see [Registration and Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguA2024#43887-registration-and-payment-details) tab for registration fee information. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers.

Please see [Registration and Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreaQualifierDaeguC2024#44023-registration-and-payment-details) tab for registration fee information. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). items.name: Summer in Bishkek 2024
items.information: Русский Summer in Bishkek 2024 - это открытый чемпионат по скоростной сборке головоломок в городе Бишкек. Базовый регистрационный взнос за 1 дисциплину составляет 200 сом. За 2 или более дисциплин взнос составляет 700 сом. Данные соревнования организованы при поддержки команды QBERS. 10 процетов от всех собранных средств будут отправлены в международную благотворительную организацию "Интеракт" Кыргызча Summer in Bishkek 2024 — Бишкек шаарында өтүүчү пазлдарды жогорку ылдамдыкта чогултуу боюнча ачык чемпионат. 1 дисциплинага негизги каттоо төлөмү 200 сом. 2 же андан көп дисциплиналар үчүн төлөм 700 сомду түзөт. Бул мелдештер QBERS командасынын колдоосу менен уюштурулууда. Бардык чогултулган каражаттардын 10 пайызы "Интеракт" эл аралык кайрымдуулук уюмуна жөнөтүлөт English Summer in Bishkek 2024 is an open championship in high-speed puzzle assembly in the city of Bishkek. The basic registration fee for 1 discipline is 200 soms. For 2 or more disciplines the fee is 700 soms. These competitions are organized with the support of the QBERS team. 10 percent of all funds raised will be sent to the international charity organization "Interact"
